title: Certification record v1
description: Typed workflow certification (IMP-0203). A stored green decays: admission is VALID only while corpus_version and spec_version match the live context and the injected clock is strictly before expiry. Evidence must name an on-disk anchor (path + sha256); a summary without an anchor is not a certificate.
$comment: Owned by IMP-0203. Not a generated command-center/schema shim. Draft-07 so admit.py Draft7Validator error paths stay stable (required-property and minLength).

workflow_id.description: Stable workflow identifier. Not a display title.

version.description: Workflow version frozen with this certificate.

corpus_version.description: IMP-0201 frozen baseline corpus id. Mismatch against live corpus => STALE.

spec_version.description: Spec/harness version frozen with this certificate. Mismatch => STALE.

anchor.description: On-disk artifact the confirmer read. A digest alone is a claim, not a receipt.

path.description: Repo-relative path. Empty string is schema-invalid.

kind.description: Certify only workflows that outperform or materially complement their sources.

confirmer.description: IMP-0202 independent confirmer. Must cite raw paths, not the author's summary alone.

issued_at.description: UTC Z instant. Admission never reads the wall clock; callers inject now.

expiry.description: UTC Z instant. now >= expiry is STALE (inclusive).
